subject: general
question: Which of the following States will host the 37th National Games?
solution:
The correct answer is **Goa**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa** has been selected to host the 37th National Games of India.
 
• The decision to host the games in Goa was made by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
• The National Games are a multi-sport event held every four years among the athletes from different states of India.
 
• The event aims to promote sportsmanship and unity among the states and territories of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 National Games
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Origin
 The **National Games** were first held in 1924 as the Indian Olympic Games.
 
 

 Frequency
 The **National Games** are held every four years.
 
 

 Participants
 Athletes from all **Indian states and Union territories** participate in the event.
 
 

 Events
 The **National Games** include a wide range of sports, from athletics to traditional games.
 
 

 Purpose
 The main aim is to promote **sportsmanship** and unity among the Indian states.
